# TorchEBM

> Simulation-free, GPU-first generative modeling in PyTorch: composable primitives for scalable, stable training of energy-based models, diffusion, flow matching, and equilibrium and energy matching.

TorchEBM is a PyTorch library for simulation-free, GPU-first generative
modeling: scalable, stable training of energy-based models, diffusion, flow
matching, and equilibrium and energy matching. Every model defines a
dynamical system on data space: a scalar energy whose gradient drives
Langevin or Hamiltonian dynamics, or a vector field (a velocity, score, or
noise prediction, time-conditioned or autonomous) that an ODE or SDE
integrates; the field need not be the gradient of an energy. The methods
share the same components: a model, a probability path, a coupling, an
objective, a sampler, and an integrator. TorchEBM implements them as
composable, high-throughput PyTorch primitives, so simulation-free
objectives (flow matching, equilibrium matching, denoising score matching)
and sampling-based objectives (contrastive divergence with Langevin or HMC
negatives) share one library. Losses take model outputs, and samplers take
the model per call, sampler(model, x, n_steps=...). Schrödinger bridges,
flow maps, and discrete or manifold state spaces are on the roadmap.

Key components:
- Samplers: LangevinDynamics, HamiltonianMonteCarlo, RiemannianManifoldHMC, GradientDescentSampler, NesterovSampler, FlowSampler
- Losses: ContrastiveDivergenceLoss, ScoreMatchingLoss, DenoisingScoreMatchingLoss, SlicedScoreMatchingLoss, FlowMatchingLoss, EquilibriumMatchingLoss, EnergyMatchingLoss
- Interpolants: LinearInterpolant, CosineInterpolant, VariancePreservingInterpolant, VarianceExplodingInterpolant
- Couplings: IndependentCoupling, GreedyCoupling, SinkhornCoupling, UnbalancedSinkhornCoupling, ExactOTCoupling
- Integrators: EulerMaruyama, Heun, RK4, Dopri5, Leapfrog, GeneralisedLeapfrog
- Models: BaseModel, AnalyticModel, DiT, TimeConditionedMLP, ClassifierFreeGuidance, InteractionModel
- Datasets: TwoMoons, EightGaussians, SwissRoll, and more synthetic benchmarks

- [Getting Started](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/getting_started/index.md): Installation and first workflows

## Concepts

- [Design and Scope](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/concepts/design/index.md): The unifying abstraction and method taxonomy
- [The Energy-Based View](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/concepts/energy_view/index.md): Energies, scores, and the model contract
- [Sampling and Integration](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/concepts/sampling/index.md): MCMC, flow sampling, and integrators
- [Learning Objectives](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/concepts/objectives/index.md): Training objectives from CD to energy matching
- [Interpolants and Couplings](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/concepts/transport/index.md): Interpolants and couplings

## API Reference

- [core](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/core/index.md): Core base classes
- [samplers](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/samplers/index.md): Sampling algorithms
- [losses](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/losses/index.md): Training objectives
- [interpolants](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/interpolants/index.md): Interpolation schemes
- [couplings](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/couplings/index.md): Couplings
- [integrators](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/integrators/index.md): Numerical integrators
- [models](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/models/index.md): Neural network architectures
- [datasets](https://soran-ghaderi.github.io/torchebm/latest/api/torchebm/datasets/index.md): Data generators
